poll.title: Atlas Edit Weekly Cycle Proposal - July 27, 2026
poll.summary: This Atlas edit proposal 1) reassigns the Core GovOps role from Atlas Axis to Soter Labs, 2) enables Grove self-governance with a new Delegation Framework, 3) requires mutual consent to modify or terminate Ecosystem Accords, 4) adds a Morpho deployment verification guide and factory-deployment review requirement, 5) exempts emergency-response multisigs from the standard signer thresholds, 6) moves Spark's USDT Sky Direct Exposure from Curve to Uniswap, 7) documents Grove Monolithic Mainnet and Foreign Controller functions, 8) consolidates Grove's Diamond PAU contracts and functions into the shared Sky Core section, 9) corrects Grove Paxos bridge Instance names and the USDT0 Underlying Asset Address, and 10) aligns Base Rate notation in the Borrow Rate Mechanism formula.
